hook: The 11-Year-Old Who Gave Lincoln His Beard
text: One autumn day, he received a letter from an eleven-year-old girl in the state of New York named Grace Bedell. She told him that she thought he would look a great deal better if he let his whiskers grow, because his face was so thin. Lincoln wrote her a kind reply. He said that he had never worn whiskers, and asked whether people would think it a piece of silly affectation if he began now. But soon afterwards, he began to grow a beard. And the face that we all remember today, the bearded face, began then.
